I rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) in all regions, and opened a SEV2 incident.

Summary of actions:
- **Diagnosed**: `get_service_status` showed checkout-api on v2.3.1, unhealthy, with a 0.18 error rate across all regions. `list_deployments` confirmed v2.3.1 was the latest deploy and unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.
- **Rolled back**: `rollback` to v2.3.0 succeeded in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
- **Opened incident**: SEV2 incident `INC-0002` for checkout-api, paging on-call, describing the health-check failure and the rollback. (The first incident-creation attempt timed out; the retry succeeded.)
